author: KadreVex
body:
I made a character once and kept him at tier 2( it's the earliest you can use ring of restraint.) Then I geared him up as good as I could and absolutely destroyed everyone in the arena... It was fun for a while 😁.
  Not exactly a challenge but somthing interesting to try.

  I was going to try and have unbeatable characters at each of the early tiers because people don't really stay in those tiers long enough to gear up well.

author: tincmetals98
body:
I am converting my Mimic King 90th Lvl character into a Challenge Account. Partially inspired by your Iron Man type question.

I am now going to try to get every Achievement Possible before 100th Level!

I also noticed it's rank is a staggering #45,803. Far above what it should be for any 90th. I can't wait to see where it gets to by the end of all achievements!

Obviously Value of Experience is out. Everything else is in.

* Frequent Visitor IV / V --- 740 / 2,000
* Monster Slayer VIII / X --- 40,160 / 250,000
* Boss Slayer IX / X --- 6,857 / 10,000
* Gladiator VII / VIII --- 7,852 / 25,000
* Explorer III / V --- 344 / 2,000
* Master Duke IV / VIII --- 620 / 25,000
* Quest Seeker IX / X --- 1,171 / 2,000
* The Traveller III / V --- 57,013 / 250,000
* Gauntlet Mater IX / X --- 1,552 / 2,000

CHALLENGE MODE

It's like playing Warsong (Sega Genesis) with only the Commanders. Commando mode on some strategy games is fun. Or single character-ing RPGs. Like soloing FFX with Auron (unless not allowed, parts).
